title: Read CVs in-browser without downloading

human_decisions.pdf_source: api/download-cv supports mode=view returning Content-Disposition inline; download keeps attachment
human_decisions.mobile: Mobile/coarse-pointer shows an Open PDF + Download fallback instead of a broken embed
human_decisions.counters: SEPARATE view counters (v:cvview:* family); downloads unchanged
human_decisions.view_counting_precision: Range requests are not counted (avoids one view counting many times)

verification.entry_bundle: mode=view no longer in the entry chunk; CVView ships as its own 5.76 kB chunk

known_limitations: vite preview does not execute the Vercel serverless handlers, so the inline
disposition and the Redis counter separation were verified by contract harness
rather than over the wire. The automation browser window is pinned at 702px,
below the 768px mobile breakpoint, so the desktop iframe branch could not be
exercised end-to-end after the refactor (it was observed rendering before it).
Real view numbers require a deployed environment with Upstash configured.
